text.text: Your home care agency in one place. Start with Referrals to answer today, then Shifts for the day's visits, and keep Credentials current so every caregiver is always cleared to work. Operational tracking only; care plans and clinical records stay in your clinical system.

views.name: Hours per week by care level

text.text: Families usually call several agencies. The first helpful call often wins.
Log the referral and set Assess by.
Call the family, listen first, then explain how an assessment works.
Book the assessment with the clinical supervisor.
Move the person to Clients and agree hours and funding.
Open Clients and check Hours per week for each active client.
Schedule shifts for next week using Schedule shift on the client.
Match caregivers to clients they already know where possible.
Check that each caregiver's credentials are Valid.
When a caregiver calls out, find cover the same day and tell the client.
Mark missed shifts Missed and note why.
Every visit should be verified before billing.
Shift marked Completed and Visit verified ticked
The scheduler lists completed shifts that are not verified and chases them before payroll.
Open Credentials and look at the Next 30 days view.
Message each caregiver with the renewal date.
Mark Renewal requested, then Valid when proof arrives.
Remove the caregiver from upcoming shifts until the credential is valid again.
